data.comment:
# Comfy Kling O1- Text to Video

Generate videos from text descriptions using Kling O1. Create dynamic video content with natural language prompts. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_kling_omni_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: A professional skateboarder performs tricks in an urban skatepark at sunset. The camera tracks the skater's movements, following each jump and spin in slow motion. The golden hour light creates dramatic silhouettes against the concrete ramps. Water droplets from a nearby fountain catch the light, and the skater's shadow stretches across the ground as they land each trick with precision.
